organizations.publicNote: Music publishing house in Vienna and Berlin. It issued the Sirius-Mappen in six annual series from 1927 to January 1933, and from 1933 the successor publication Tonfilm Theater Tanz, which ran to 1943. No name register carries the firm: the GND holds three bodies called Sirius, one German, one unplaced and one an Austrian company registered under a legal form introduced in 2007, and none of them is this house.

sources.researchNote: The index names four Kaper numbers with their year and issue: “Wenn ich ’mal eine Dummheit mach’” (33-04), “Immer, wenn ich glücklich bin, muß ich schrecklich weinen” (33-10), “In 24 Stunden kann soviel gescheh’n” (33-11) and “Heut’ ist Karneval” (35-08), the last already cited from the issue itself. Two of them bear on the joint pseudonym: the index credits “Immer, wenn ich glücklich bin” and “In 24 Stunden kann soviel gescheh’n” openly to Jurmann and Kaper, where Hofmeister registered both under the printed composer name Ernst Martin. The index is evidence of contents, not of a credit line; the three 1933 issues have not been examined, and the wording printed on them remains to be read.
